reference_sql:
WITH june_lines AS (  -- one row per June 2024 order line
  SELECT o.store_id, ol.unit_price_eur, p.unit_cost_eur
  FROM order_lines ol
  JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
  JOIN products p ON p.product_id = ol.product_id
  WHERE o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2024-06-01' AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2024-07-01'
)
SELECT s.store_code, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE j.unit_price_eur > 10 * j.unit_cost_eur) / NULLIF(COUNT(j.store_id), 0) AS cents_share
FROM stores s
LEFT JOIN june_lines j ON j.store_id = s.store_id
GROUP BY s.store_code

WITH per_store AS (  -- one row per store with June 2024 lines
  SELECT o.store_id, COUNT(*) AS n_lines,
         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ol.unit_price_eur > 10 * p.unit_cost_eur) AS n_cents
  FROM order_lines ol
  JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
  JOIN products p ON p.product_id = ol.product_id
  WHERE o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2024-06-01' AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2024-07-01'
  GROUP BY o.store_id
)
SELECT s.store_code, ps.n_cents / NULLIF(ps.n_lines, 0) AS cents_share
FROM stores s
LEFT JOIN per_store ps ON ps.store_id = s.store_id

WITH june_lines AS (  -- one row per June 2024 order line
  SELECT o.store_id, ol.unit_price_eur, p.unit_cost_eur
  FROM order_lines ol
  JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
  JOIN products p ON p.product_id = ol.product_id
  WHERE o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2024-06-01' AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2024-07-01'
)
SELECT s.store_code, SUM(CASE WHEN j.unit_price_eur > 10 * j.unit_cost_eur THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(j.store_id), 0) AS cents_share
FROM stores s
LEFT JOIN june_lines j ON j.store_id = s.store_id
GROUP BY s.store_code

solver.query:
WITH j AS (
  SELECT o.store_id, ol.unit_price_eur > 10 * p.unit_cost_eur AS cents
  FROM order_lines ol
  JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
  LEFT JOIN products p ON p.product_id = ol.product_id
  WHERE o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2024-06-01' AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2024-07-01'
)
SELECT s.store_code, count(*) FILTER (WHERE j.cents) * 1.0 / NULLIF(count(j.store_id), 0) AS cents_share
FROM stores s
LEFT JOIN j ON j.store_id = s.store_id
GROUP BY s.store_code
